description:
Make container archive planning recognise an issue outside the container subtree that explicitly links an embedded artifact as that artifact's owner, so an artifact a live container owns is copied or retained instead of moved.

## Background

- A container preview over `f4d9502a` (`jit archive container f4d9502a --json`) plans `dev/active/9db27a3a-v1-0/handoff-2026-10-23-codex.md` as `"action": "move"` with `"provenance": ["embedded"]`, `"owners": []` and `"evidence": []`, and lists the source under `pending_deletions`.
- That file is an explicit document reference of the live milestone `9db27a3a` (`jit doc list 9db27a3a` lists it), which is outside `f4d9502a`'s subtree. It is embedded in the subtree because `dev/active/f4d9502a-git-cli-module/handoff.md` links it.
- Another embedded artifact owned outside the subtree in the same plan, `dev/active/5046408a/diagnostics-proposal.md`, is planned as `"action": "copy"` with `"evidence": ["outside-owner"]`, so the classifier does recognise outside owners in some cases; the owner set it consults for the handoff file omits `9db27a3a`.
- Ownership selection and the outside-owner evidence live in `crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_classifier.rs` (`select_direct_owners`, `embedded_owners_by_path`, `embedded_owner_is_outside`); the owner inventory is assembled by the archive planner in `crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs` (`capture_archive_plan`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An embedded artifact that an issue outside the container subtree lists as a document reference reports that issue among its owners and carries `outside-owner` evidence in a container plan, whether that owner is terminal or not.
- [hard] REQ-02: Such an artifact is never planned as a move while that outside owner is non-terminal; its action is the one the classifier gives other outside-owned embedded artifacts, and preview and execution agree on it.
- [hard] REQ-03: A command test builds a container whose subtree document links an artifact owned by a live issue outside the subtree and asserts REQ-01 and REQ-02; it fails on the code this issue starts from, which plans the artifact as an ownerless move.

## Notes

- Found by a preview of the completed epic `f4d9502a`; no archive run happened.
title: Container archive plans treat an outside owner's embedded artifact as ownerless
